source: Direct user instruction in side conversation after review of F005 pair_A_oblique/front
user_instruction: That's not acceptable. We must build this so that when everything is put together the border of the escutcheon is equidistant all the way around.
requirement: The visible custom backing-plate border must have constant width around the entire actual assembled decorative-cover perimeter. For the circular Kohler covers, use circular outer outlines concentric with the actual cover, with zero intentional X/Y offset. Maintain this relationship when later measurements reconcile cover registration.
same_width_between_both_plates: Not explicitly required; include a comparison with matching widths on both.
rejected_F005_appearances: MAIN-A: 6 mm upward offset produces unequal top and bottom exposure
MAIN-B: rounded rectangle and 5 mm upward offset cannot give constant-width exposure around a circular cover
DIV-B: rounded-square outline cannot give constant-width exposure around a circular cover
implementation_constraints: Resolve spacing by evaluating diameters and coverage, never by offsetting the backing outline from its cover.
Retain the installed-coordinate insertion aperture, original scan, valves, studs, factory inner plates, foam, drainage and service functions.
Installed concentricity needs a repeatable locating method and physical verification; exact CAD concentricity is not proof of installed alignment.
Evaluate full 360-degree border variation and inter-plate clearance after cover registration is measured.
Keep rejected F005 files as historical evidence; new concentric study files are separate unselected drafts.

study.main_cover_basis: User tape measurement; installed center remains inferred
study.diverter_cover_basis: Manufacturer nominal value already recorded in canon/design_decisions.json; actual part unmeasured
study.thickness_basis: Existing SS060 stock trial, not a selected material or thickness
study.aperture_basis: Reuse F005 main insertion contour in installed coordinates and 80 mm diverter aperture trial
study.limits: Projected damage coverage only. Physical scale, exact cover centers, rear foam, minimum supported seal land, stud/cover fit and installed water performance remain unresolved. Smaller main plates reduce the previous exploratory 10 mm sound-land allowance; this is explicitly not accepted as a seal design.
